sources.title: Visa Requirements for the Virgin Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Government visa-application service directly adopts this Government-hosted PDF as its Visa Requirements schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of the following countries require a visa to enter the Virgin Islands.

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands: travel documents for entry FAQ

sources.supportingExcerpt: A valid passport and if a visa is required, it should be included in your passport before entry.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: current named visa-required nationalities
policies.summary: The live Government visa service directs visa-required nationalities to its linked schedule; the approved visa is returned by email before travel and must be included before entry.
conditions: This applies to an ordinary passport of a nationality expressly named without a purpose limitation in the current Government-linked schedule, for a short visitor entry.
The service says an approved visa is returned by email; travel should not be booked until it is issued, and the entry FAQ requires any visa before entry.

Belarus, Moldova, Russia and Ukraine remain listed as visa-required for the ordinary baseline; the schedule limited mega-yacht waiver is a vessel-, duration-, and purpose-conditioned exception, not a nationality-wide substitute.
A valid UK, United States or Canadian visa may furnish a separate document-conditioned exemption for a visitor; it is not a nationality-wide ordinary-passport policy.

policies.title: British Virgin Islands: Chinese ordinary passport tourism/business visitor exception
policies.summary: The current service-linked schedule limits the Chinese visa requirement to purposes other than tourism and business, establishing no advance visa requirement for the short tourism/business baseline.
conditions: Limited to an ordinary Chinese passport holder visiting for tourism or business.
The schedule expressly excludes Hong Kong SAR from its China row; that territorial wording is not generalized to Hong Kong or other special-document categories.
